items.definition:
a return to a normal state of health, mind, or strength
Her recovery from the illness was slow but steady.

a member of a senate
The senator gave a speech about the new bill.

a place of study or training
He enrolled in a military academy.

a distinct compound or substance
Be careful when handling strong chemicals.

an alphabetical list of names, subjects, etc., with the page numbers where they are mentioned
Check the index at the back of the book.

the branch of a nation's armed forces that conducts military operations at sea
My brother joined the navy.

resistance or dissent, expressed in action or argument
There was strong opposition to the new policy.

delegate, spokesperson
Our sales representative will contact you soon.

plan, system
The new marketing scheme was very successful.

valuable item, advantage
Her experience is a great asset to the team.

fighting, battle
The soldiers were trained for combat.

sadness, economic downturn
She sought help for her depression.

elegance, divine favor
She moved with elegance and grace.

production, making of goods
The manufacturing industry is crucial for the economy.

the process of extracting minerals from the earth
Coal mining is a dangerous but essential industry.

a particular attitude toward or way of regarding something
Try to see the situation from her perspective.

a forcible overthrow of a government or social order
The industrial revolution changed society dramatically.

a nonmetallic element
Carbon dioxide is a greenhouse gas.

a person appointed to act as a substitute for another
The deputy mayor attended the meeting.

the inner part of something
The interior of the house was beautifully decorated.

the process of preserving a condition or situation
The building requires regular maintenance.

a feeling of reassurance; aid
It was a great relief to finish the exam.

opposition; ability to withstand
The material has high resistance to heat.

the sale of goods to the public
She works in retail.

a competition to find the best
They won the national championship.

a large group of states or countries under a single authority
The Roman Empire was vast.

the act of increasing in size or scope
The company announced its expansion into new markets.

an event or occurrence
There was a minor incident at the party.

a member of a body of troops trained to serve on land or at sea
He joined the Marine Corps.

the point of highest activity, intensity, or achievement
We reached the peak of the mountain.

a substance found in food such as meat, eggs, and milk, that is an important part of the human diet
Meat and fish are good sources of protein.

the first public appearance of a performer or sports player
Her debut album was a huge success.

treatment for an illness or injury
She is undergoing physical therapy for her knee injury.

a person who sees an event
The police asked the witness for a description.

a person in command, especially of a military unit
The commander gave the order to advance.

the action of defending or protecting
The country's defence system is strong.

a system of government by the whole population
Democracy is a fundamental principle of this nation.

a way of carrying out a particular task
She has a unique technique for painting.

a general direction in which something is developing or changing
The latest fashion trend is very colorful.

an abundance of valuable possessions or money
He accumulated great wealth over the years.

the action of approving something
The project needs final approval from the manager.

a particular part or feature of something
We considered every aspect of the plan.

a way in which something is usually done; a large meeting or conference
It's a social convention to shake hands when you meet someone new.

an organized group of criminals; a group of friends
A gang of friends went to the movies.

a rule or directive made and maintained by an authority
New safety regulations were introduced.

expression of disapproval
He received a lot of criticism for his performance.

deoxyribonucleic acid
DNA carries genetic information in all living organisms.

the process of forming or being formed
The rock formation was millions of years old.

a group of people who decide a verdict in court
The jury delivered its verdict after two days of deliberation.

the study of fundamental nature of knowledge, reality, and existence
She is studying philosophy at university.

a place where people establish a community
The early settlement grew into a large town.

a relationship between partners
They formed a partnership to start the new business.

a physical or mental feature indicating a condition
Fever is a common symptom of the flu.

a room, especially a private room or a room used for a specific purpose
The king held court in the royal chamber.

a closed path through which electricity can flow
The electrician checked the circuit for any faults.

a result or effect of an action or condition
The severe drought was a direct consequence of climate change.

the degree to which something has spread or been affected
We don't know the full extent of the damage yet.

the organized provision of medical care to individuals or a community
Access to affordable healthcare is a major concern.

the action of coming to live permanently in a foreign country
Immigration policies are often debated by politicians.

a person or thing that kills
The police are still searching for the killer.

a mountain or hill (often used in names)
We hiked to the top of Mount Everest.

a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one
The committee reviewed the new budget proposal.

a principal administrative division of certain countries or empires
Quebec is a large province in Canada.

the action or process of recognizing or being recognized
He received recognition for his outstanding work.
